Description: Checks that SMS is not active as an org-wide MFA method.
Risk: SMS MFA can be abused through SIM swap, interception, and social engineering.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authenticators or Security > Multifactor.
2. Confirm users have an alternative authenticator such as Okta Verify, FastPass, or Passkeys.
3. Remove SMS from authenticator enrollment policies and recovery flows where possible.
4. Deactivate the SMS/Phone OTP authenticator or factor.
5. Monitor sign-in and recovery helpdesk volume after migration.

Recommendation.Text: Disable SMS as an MFA authenticator and migrate users to phishing-resistant or stronger possession factors.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
